name: NodeJS Universal v1.1 TEST
author: consolex1@consolex1.com
description: Universal Node.js egg for Node.js 20, 22 and 26. Dependencies are installed during server installation, never at startup. Supports npm, pnpm and Yarn.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

SERVER_DIR="/home/container"

log() {
    echo "[NodeJS] $*"
}

fail() {
    echo
    echo "[NodeJS] ERROR: $*" >&2
    exit 1
}

trap 'fail "Installation failed at line $LINENO."' ERR

cd "$SERVER_DIR"

echo
echo "========================================"
echo " Node.js Universal Installer v1.1"
echo "========================================"
echo

if [[ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" == "1" || "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" == "true" ]]; then
    log "User upload mode enabled."
    log "Skipping Git and dependency installation."
    exit 0
fi

if [[ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]]; then
    REPO_URL="${GIT_ADDRESS}"

    if [[ "$REPO_URL" != *.git ]]; then
        REPO_URL="${REPO_URL}.git"
    fi

    if [[ -n "${GIT_USERNAME:-}" && -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
        REPO_HOST="$(printf '%s' "$REPO_URL" | sed -E 's#^https?://##')"
        REPO_URL="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${REPO_HOST}"
    fi

    if [[ -d ".git" ]]; then
        log "Git repository detected."

        if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-0}" == "1" || "${AUTO_UPDATE:-0}" == "true" ]]; then
            log "Updating repository..."
            git fetch --all --prune

            if [[ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]]; then
                git checkout "$BRANCH"
                git pull origin "$BRANCH"
            else
                git pull
            fi
        else
            log "AUTO_UPDATE disabled."
        fi

    elif [[ -n "$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ]]; then
        log "Server directory is not empty."
        log "Skipping Git clone to protect existing files."

    else
        log "Cloning repository..."

        if [[ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]]; then
            git clone --single-branch --branch "$BRANCH" "$REPO_URL" .
        else
            git clone "$REPO_URL" .
        fi
    fi
fi

if [[ ! -f package.json ]]; then
    log "No package.json found."
    log "Nothing to install."
    exit 0
fi

PACKAGE_MANAGER="$(node -e '
try {
    const pkg = require("./package.json");
    process.stdout.write(pkg.packageManager || "");
} catch {
    process.stdout.write("");
}
')"

log "Node.js: $(node --version)"
log "npm: $(npm --version)"

if [[ -n "$PACKAGE_MANAGER" ]]; then
    log "packageManager: $PACKAGE_MANAGER"
else
    log "packageManager: not specified"
fi

install_npm() {
    if [[ -f package-lock.json ]]; then
        log "package-lock.json detected."
        log "Running npm ci..."
        npm ci
    else
        log "No package-lock.json detected."
        log "Running npm install..."
        npm install
    fi
}

install_pnpm() {
    if [[ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]]; then
        log "pnpm-lock.yaml detected."
        log "Running pnpm install --frozen-lockfile..."
        corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    else
        log "No pnpm lockfile detected."
        log "Running pnpm install..."
        corepack pnpm install
    fi

    log "Rebuilding native dependencies..."
    corepack pnpm rebuild
}

install_yarn() {
    YARN_VERSION="$(corepack yarn --version)"
    log "Yarn version: $YARN_VERSION"

    if [[ "$YARN_VERSION" == 1.* ]]; then
        if [[ -f yarn.lock ]]; then
            log "Yarn 1 lockfile detected."
            log "Running yarn install --frozen-lockfile..."
            corepack yarn install --frozen-lockfile
        else
            log "Running yarn install..."
            corepack yarn install
        fi
    else
        if [[ -f yarn.lock ]]; then
            log "Modern Yarn lockfile detected."
            log "Running yarn install --immutable..."
            corepack yarn install --immutable
        else
            log "Running yarn install..."
            corepack yarn install
        fi
    fi
}

if [[ -n "$PACKAGE_MANAGER" ]]; then
    case "$PACKAGE_MANAGER" in
        npm@*)
            log "Package manager selected: npm"
            install_npm
            ;;
        pnpm@*)
            log "Package manager selected: pnpm"
            install_pnpm
            ;;
        yarn@*)
            log "Package manager selected: yarn"
            install_yarn
            ;;
        *)
            fail "Unsupported packageManager: $PACKAGE_MANAGER"
            ;;
    esac
elif [[ -f package-lock.json ]]; then
    log "Detected package-lock.json."
    install_npm
elif [[ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]]; then
    log "Detected pnpm-lock.yaml."
    install_pnpm
elif [[ -f yarn.lock ]]; then
    log "Detected yarn.lock."
    install_yarn
else
    log "No package manager or lockfile detected."
    log "Falling back to npm."
    npm install
fi

echo
echo "========================================"
echo " Installation complete"
echo "========================================"
echo

log "Node.js: $(node --version)"
log "npm: $(npm --version)"
log "All dependencies installed successfully."

variables.name: Startup Command
variables.description: Command used to start the Node.js application. Dependencies are installed during server installation.

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description: Optional Git repository to clone during installation.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: When enabled, update an existing Git repository during installation.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Set to 1 to skip Git and dependency installation.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Optional Git username for private repositories.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Optional Git access token for private repositories.
